# Chantamas "Joopjip" Chatraporn — Project Manager, Toronto

> PMP-certified project manager and commercial professional (business development, strategy) with seven years in pharma, medtech and consumer health. Based in Toronto, ON; open to project management, business development and strategy roles. Also builds her own job-search tools, including an autonomous Claude-agent résumé generator.

## Projects
- [AI Résumé Generator — source](https://github.com/JJoopjip/ai-resume-generator): headless Claude agent that tailors a one-page résumé to a job posting and scores coverage
- [Job Application Tracker — source](https://github.com/JJoopjip/application-tracker): Flask kanban board and dashboard fed by the résumé generator
